root_cause: The Windows Debug build completed successfully (compile, install, packaging, JS/node package build all succeeded) but the final 'Store artifacts to a shared drive' step, which copies openvino_package.zip, developer_package.zip, openvino_tests.zip, manifest.yml, openvino_js_package.zip, and openvino_node_npm_package.zip to the network-mounted share at C:\mount\build-artifacts, failed every single copy with WinError 112 ('There is not enough space on the disk'). This is not a PR-code issue: PR #39101 only touches GitHub Actions workflow YAML/JS for GenAI/LLM wheel installation and does not affect the Windows build or the store_artifacts action. The destination directory for the commit was also never created (the subsequent FileNotFoundError on workflow_link.txt confirms the folder write failed), consistent with the shared drive/storage volume being full or over quota at the time of the run, an infrastructure capacity problem outside the PR's control.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; requires the shared CI storage volume (C:\mount\build-artifacts) to be at capacity. To confirm, check disk usage/quota of the `build-artifacts` share around 2026-11-04T23:08 UTC and look for cleanup/retention jobs for old commit artifacts.
recommended_actions: Check and free up space on the C:\mount\build-artifacts shared drive (Windows CI artifact storage volume) or increase its quota/capacity
Verify/trigger the artifact retention/cleanup job for old commit directories under dldt/master/commit/* on that share
Re-run the failed Build job once storage space is confirmed available - this PR's own changes are not implicated
Add disk-space pre-check or alerting on the shared artifact storage to catch near-full conditions before jobs fail
prevention_strategies: Add proactive monitoring/alerting on the shared artifact storage volume's free space, and an automated retention policy that prunes old per-commit artifact directories so the share does not silently fill up and fail unrelated builds.
historical_context: No prior pattern record for this exact signature (disk-full WinError 112 on the shared artifact drive) was found in the CI Doctor MQ pattern database; this is the first recorded occurrence.
